text.text_excerpt: Ok, so it's 8pm, post happy hour. We're all hanging out and no one's had dinner. A friend just got these coupons in her mailbox for a new place called Hungry Howie's. Another friend (from Atlanta) can't stop ranting and raving about this place. So, I call. The guy on the phone was incredibly customer service oriented. He helped me find the best deal for our group of 8 (apparently, my 3 medium pizzas for $15 was only for single toppings). They estimated a 30-45 minute delivery. It took 40 minutes and the pizza arrived piping HOT! The crust is delicious. My favorite was the butter cheese. Yum! Certainly my most favorite pizza delivery around. I hope they keep up the excellent customer servi...

I guess I'm lucky I haven't had any negative experiences with howies, like a lot of the reviews I have seen. I have eaten food from here at friends and ordered on my own and it's always been perfect. It's delivery pizza. I'm not a chain restaurant kinda girl, as you see from most of my reviews. But, it serves it's purpose well and it's delicious when I have had a rough weekend and don't want to cook, or put on real clothes. Their delivery fee is about $1 too high and I'm hoping the delivery people get a good chunk of it, as most chains give a gas refund as a percentage of each delivery fee to drivers to cover people who don't tip (rude, btw). I finally took the dive and ordered Hungry Howie's for delivery through their website. The ordering process was seamless. I was quoted 40 minutes, but my order arrived in 30 with the delivery driver calling to say he had arrived. The driver was professional and I incurred no problems. The food arrived hot, and it was actually good. My biggest compliment is their chicken wings. Compared to other pizza places, their wings are top notch! The wings are huge and I feel like I'm actually eating a chicken's wing and not a baby pigeon. The item that I highly disliked was the cinnamon bread.
